subject: txn: make load data transactional (#49079)
summary: Reviewed executor/privilege impact for transactional LOAD DATA. `pkg/executor/load_data.go` removes the internal per-batch txn commit/rollback path so LOAD DATA runs as a normal statement within the session transaction (enabling rollback and explicit txn semantics). LOCAL INFILE now obtains an `io.ReadCloser` via `LoadDataReaderBuilderKey` in `LoadDataExec.Open` and closes it on error/Close. Privilege changes are limited to test adjustments (no privilege semantics change). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the requested scope.
